table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AppointmentCode,
	DoctCode,
	Date,
	TokenNo,
	AppointmentMethodCode,
	AppointmentStatusCode,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = VisitAppointment.PatientCode),
	PatientCode,
	PatientDetails,
	ReferredBy,
	Remarks,
	Comments,
	Posted,
	UserCode,

	DDate = DueDate, 
	DTime = DueDate,

/*
	DDate = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), DueDate, 101) AS DATETIME), 
	DTime = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), DueDate, 114) AS DATETIME),
*/
	DueDate
FROM
	DBO.VisitAppointment
WHERE
	AppointmentCode = :ai_code
